item.text: The mark now reads as both an “F” and two unfurling leaves, with a thicker stem for the favicon. The logo uses one ink color, making it suitable for a bookplate or café stamp. I’m finishing the light and dark versions and size checks.

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/fernway-final-work/finalize.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/fernway-final-work')
from build import wordmark
from render import render
out=Path.cwd()
ink='#382C27';paper='#F8F1E5'
p,width=wordmark('Noto Serif',1)
master='M9 45H14.5V30C27 32.2 39.5 26.5 40 18C29.5 16.8 19.3 18.5 14.5 24.5V15.5C28 17.5 41.2 11.9 42 3C25.1 1.4 9 5.4 9 18Z'
small='M3 15H5V10C10 11 13 9 13 6C9 5.5 6.5 6.2 5 8V5C10 6 14 4 14 1C8 .5 3 1.8 3 6Z'
def logo(color):
 return f'''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"552\" height=\"144\" viewBox=\"0 0 552 144\" role=\"img\" aria-labelledby=\"fernway-title fernway-desc\">
  <title id=\"fernway-title\">Fernway</title>
  <desc id=\"fernway-desc\">A leafy F beside an outlined serif wordmark for Fernway, an independent bookshop and café in Portland, Oregon.</desc>
  <g fill=\"{color}\">
    <path d=\"{master}\" transform=\"translate(8 19) scale(1.7)\"/>
    <path d=\"{p}\" transform=\"translate(104 96)\"/>
  </g>
</svg>
'''
(out/'logo.svg').write_text(logo(ink))
(out/'logo-reversed.svg').write_text(logo(paper))
(out/'mark.svg').write_text(f'''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" role=\"img\" aria-labelledby=\"fernway-mark-title\" color=\"{ink}\">
  <title id=\"fernway-mark-title\">Fernway</title>
  <style>@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {{ :root {{ color: {paper}; }} }}</style>
  <path fill=\"currentColor\" d=\"{small}\"/>
</svg>
''')
# Render a presentation containing the full lockup and actual 128/32/16px marks.
parts=['<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"1104\" height=\"560\" viewBox=\"0 0 1104 560\">',
'<rect width=\"1104\" height=\"560\" fill=\"#FFFFFF\"/>',f'<rect x=\"552\" width=\"552\" height=\"560\" fill=\"{ink}\"/>']
for col,color in [(0,ink),(552,paper)]:
 parts.append(f'<g transform=\"translate({col} 64)\" fill=\"{color}\"><path d=\"{master}\" transform=\"translate(8 19) scale(1.7)\"/><path d=\"{p}\" transform=\"translate(104 96)\"/></g>')
 for x,size in [(64,128),(272,32),(392,16)]:
  parts.append(f'<path fill=\"{color}\" d=\"{small}\" transform=\"translate({col+x} {352-size/2}) scale({size/16})\"/>')
  label,_=wordmark('Noto Sans',0,f'{size} px')
  parts.append(f'<path fill=\"{color}\" d=\"{label}\" transform=\"translate({col+x} 452) scale(.13)\"/>')
parts.append('</svg>')
proof=Path('/tmp/fernway-final-work/proof.svg');proof.write_text(''.join(parts))
render(proof,out/'logo-preview.png')
for size in [16,32,128]:
 render(out/'mark.svg',f'/tmp/fernway-final-work/mark-{size}.png',size,size)
 render(out/'mark.svg',f'/tmp/fernway-final-work/mark-{size}-dark.png',size,size,bg=ink,ink=paper)
# Structural checks: vector paths only, accessible names, square favicon, and no font dependency.
for filename in ['logo.svg','logo-reversed.svg','mark.svg']:
 root=ET.parse(out/filename).getroot()
 assert root.get('viewBox') and root.get('role')=='img'
 assert any(el.tag.endswith('title') for el in root)
 assert not any(el.tag.split('}')[-1] in ['text','image','foreignObject','script'] for el in root.iter())
 print(f'{filename}: valid SVG, outlined paths, accessible name, {len((out/filename).read_bytes())} bytes')
PY
python3 /tmp/fernway-final-work/finalize.py"

Created a leafy “F” paired with a warm serif wordmark in ink brown. Lettering is outlined, and the icon is checked at 16px with dark-mode support.
